episodes.title: பின்னால் நிற்பது யார்?
episodes.summary: At 3 a.m. Arjun, new tenant of a cheap old building, gets a photo of himself asleep, taken inside his locked room. A second photo shows a long-haired woman behind his bed; she comes closer in each photo. The watchman calls: don't turn around, I can see you on camera.
episodes.cliffhanger: The watchman screams that she is standing right behind him; Arjun slowly turns.

episodes.title: இறந்த பெண்
episodes.summary: Arjun runs to the watchman's room. The CCTV shows two Arjuns in his room, one standing still. The watchman shows a newspaper: Meera died in that room ten years ago, and everyone here gets her photo before they die. The paper is dated tomorrow, with Arjun's photo.
episodes.cliffhanger: On the monitor Meera stands behind the watchman, finger on her lips: he must not learn the truth yet.

episodes.title: உண்மையான பேய் யார்?
episodes.summary: Meera sent the photos to warn Arjun. The watchman is a demon who takes the faces of the people he kills and wears them to fool the next one; it killed Meera ten years ago. His face cracks to reveal Arjun's face. Meera pulls Arjun out into the rain.
episodes.cliffhanger: A last photo shows the watchman behind Arjun outside; across the road the demon smiles, wearing Arjun's face.
